tool_signatures.name: create_access_policy
tool_signatures.description: Create a workspace access policy for users, groups, and agents targeting MCP tools or provider models. Changes who may access those targets. An omitted effect becomes deny only when both user ANY and agent ANY are present; otherwise allow, which requires a specific subject. Returns the policy UUID; use get_access_policy before later updates.

tool_signatures.name: create_collection
tool_signatures.description: Create a new prompt collection for organizing prompts by app. Use this when you need a new namespace before create_prompt; set parent_collection_id to nest it under an existing collection. Returns the collection id and slug, and does not move any prompts.

tool_signatures.name: create_config
tool_signatures.description: Create a config that defines routing, cache, retry, and targets for requests; use update_config to modify an existing one and list_config_versions for history. At least one setting is required, new configs become active immediately once referenced by a key or prompt, and the call returns the new id and version_id.

tool_signatures.name: delete_access_policy
tool_signatures.description: Delete an access policy by UUID, removing its allow or deny rule and changing access permissions. This cannot be undone by this tool. Inspect get_access_policy first; returns Portkey

tool_signatures.name: delete_collection
tool_signatures.description: Delete a prompt collection by ID. This cannot be undone; prompts stay in the workspace but lose their collection grouping, so reassign them first if organization matters.

tool_signatures.name: delete_config
tool_signatures.description: Delete a config by slug. This is permanent, removes all versions, and breaks anything still pointing at that slug; check list_config_versions first.

tool_signatures.name: get_access_policy
tool_signatures.description: Read one access policy

tool_signatures.name: get_analytics_group_a2a
tool_signatures.description: Get a paginated per-agent breakdown with total_groups, group_count, and an agents array containing each A2A (agent-to-agent) agent name and its request count. Use this to see which agents receive the most traffic; use get_analytics_group_mcp for MCP servers instead.

tool_signatures.name: get_analytics_group_mcp
tool_signatures.description: Get a paginated per-MCP-server breakdown with total_groups, group_count, and an mcp_servers array containing each server name and its request count. Use this to see which MCP servers receive the most traffic; use get_analytics_group_a2a for A2A agents or get_analytics_group_users and get_analytics_group_models for other breakdowns.

tool_signatures.name: get_analytics_group_metadata
tool_signatures.description: Get a paginated metadata breakdown with total_groups, group_count, and a metadata_groups array grouped by the required metadata_key. Use this for custom breakdowns like per-environment or per-feature analysis; pass metadata_key in addition to the time window.

tool_signatures.name: get_analytics_group_models
tool_signatures.description: Get a paginated per-model breakdown with total_groups, group_count, and a models array containing request count, cost, and token usage. Use this to compare model cost, popularity, and efficiency; use get_token_analytics or get_cost_analytics for time-series trends instead.

tool_signatures.name: get_analytics_group_providers
tool_signatures.description: Enterprise-gated. Get provider-grouped analytics for one workspace and time range with selectable metrics, ordering, pagination, and optional total count. Use this when comparing provider traffic or reliability; requested metric fields are preserved in each provider row.

tool_signatures.name: get_analytics_group_users
tool_signatures.description: Get a paginated per-user breakdown with total_groups, group_count, and a users array containing request count, cost, and token usage. Use this for billing, audits, or top-consumer analysis; use get_users_analytics for aggregate active and new user trends.

tool_signatures.name: get_analytics_group_workspaces
tool_signatures.description: Get a paginated per-workspace breakdown with total_groups, group_count, is_quota_exceeded when reported, and a workspaces array containing each workspace_slug with request count and cost. Use this for org-wide chargeback or comparing workspaces; pass workspace_slug to other analytics tools to drill into one workspace.

tool_signatures.name: get_cache_hit_latency
tool_signatures.description: Get cache-hit-only latency time-series data with summary.total_latency, summary.avg_latency, and per-bucket total/avg latency. Use this to evaluate cached-response speed; use get_latency_analytics for all requests.

tool_signatures.name: get_cache_hit_rate
tool_signatures.description: Get cache-effectiveness time-series data with summary.hit_rate, summary.total_hits, summary.total_misses, and per-bucket hits/misses/rate. Use this to measure cache effectiveness; use get_cache_hit_latency for speed rather than hit/miss ratio.

tool_signatures.name: get_cache_summary
tool_signatures.description: Enterprise-gated. Get cache summary metrics for one workspace and time range: hits, average cache-hit latency, total requests, and percentage speedup. Use the graph cache tools when you need changes over time instead of one aggregate.

tool_signatures.name: get_collection
tool_signatures.description: Fetch one collection by id or slug and return its name, slug, workspace, parent collection id, child collections with prompt counts, and timestamps. Use list_collections when browsing and get_collection when you already know the target.

tool_signatures.name: get_config
tool_signatures.description: Get one config by slug and return its routing, cache, retry, and target settings. Requires a known slug; use list_configs to discover one before editing.

tool_signatures.name: get_cost_analytics
tool_signatures.description: Get cost time-series data with summary.total_cost, summary.average_cost_per_request, and per-bucket total/avg cost. Use this for spend analysis and spike detection; use get_token_analytics when you need token volume instead of monetary cost.

tool_signatures.name: get_error_analytics
tool_signatures.description: Get error-count time-series data with summary.total_errors and per-bucket counts. Use this for high-level error trends; use get_error_rate_analytics for percentages, or get_error_status_codes_analytics and get_error_stacks_analytics for breakdowns.

tool_signatures.name: get_error_rate_analytics
tool_signatures.description: Get error-rate time-series data with summary.error_rate_percent and per-bucket percentages of total requests. Use this for reliability and SLA trends; use get_error_analytics for absolute error counts instead.

tool_signatures.name: get_error_stacks_analytics
tool_signatures.description: Get stacked error-series data grouped by HTTP status code over time, with summary and per-code series. Use this to see which error classes dominate; use get_error_status_codes_analytics for distinct-code distribution instead.

tool_signatures.name: get_error_status_codes_analytics
tool_signatures.description: Get HTTP error-code distribution time-series data with summary and per-code series. Use this to see which codes occur most often; use get_error_stacks_analytics for stacked or cumulative breakdowns.

tool_signatures.name: get_feedback_analytics
tool_signatures.description: Get feedback-submission time-series data with summary totals and per-bucket counts. Use this as the top-level feedback trend view; use get_feedback_models_analytics, get_feedback_scores_analytics, or get_feedback_weighted_analytics for breakdowns.

tool_signatures.name: get_feedback_models_analytics
tool_signatures.description: Get feedback time-series data grouped by model, with per-model counts over time. Use this to compare feedback volume and satisfaction across models; use get_feedback_analytics for the overall total instead.

tool_signatures.name: get_feedback_scores_analytics
tool_signatures.description: Get raw feedback-score distribution time-series data with per-score buckets. Use this to understand sentiment mix; use get_feedback_weighted_analytics for calibrated scores with weighting.

tool_signatures.name: get_feedback_weighted_analytics
tool_signatures.description: Get weighted feedback-score time-series data using the weight recorded at feedback creation. Use this for calibrated quality metrics; use get_feedback_scores_analytics for the raw unweighted distribution.

tool_signatures.name: get_latency_analytics
tool_signatures.description: Get latency time-series data with summary.avg_latency_ms, summary.p50_latency_ms, summary.p90_latency_ms, summary.p99_latency_ms, and per-bucket latency percentiles in ms. Use this to spot slowdowns and regressions; use get_cache_hit_latency when you only want cache-hit latency.

tool_signatures.name: get_request_analytics
tool_signatures.description: Get request-volume time-series data with summary.total_requests, summary.successful_requests, summary.failed_requests, and per-bucket total/success/failed counts. Use this for traffic and reliability trends; use get_error_analytics when you only need error counts.

tool_signatures.name: get_rescued_requests_analytics
tool_signatures.description: Get rescued-request time-series data showing requests recovered by retry or fallback handling. Use this only when your configs include resilience features, and use it to measure how often recovery logic saved requests.

tool_signatures.name: get_token_analytics
tool_signatures.description: Get token-usage time-series data with summary.total_tokens, summary.prompt_tokens, summary.completion_tokens, and per-bucket total/prompt/completion counts. Use this for consumption trends; use get_cost_analytics when you need spend instead of token volume.

tool_signatures.name: get_user_requests_analytics
tool_signatures.description: Get per-user request-count time-series data with counts grouped by user. Use this to find heavy users and traffic concentration; use get_users_analytics for aggregate active and new user trends instead.

tool_signatures.name: get_users_analytics
tool_signatures.description: Get user-growth time-series data with summary.total_active_users, summary.total_new_users, and per-bucket active/new user counts. Use this for growth and adoption trends; use get_user_requests_analytics for per-user traffic or get_analytics_group_users for per-user cost and token detail.

tool_signatures.name: list_access_policies
tool_signatures.description: Inspect active workspace access policies, newest first, without changing permissions. Filter by subject, MCP server, effect, enabled state, or creation time. Returns total and the current page of policy summaries with versions; use get_access_policy for complete subjects and targets.

tool_signatures.name: list_audit_logs
tool_signatures.description: List audit log records for a Portkey organization within a time range (Enterprise plan only; other plans get a permissions error). Each record is a state-changing API request (POST, PUT, or DELETE) with timestamp, method, uri, request_id, user_id, user_type (user or api_key), organisation_id, workspace_id, response_status_code, resource_type, action, client_ip, country, plus request_body, query_params, and request_headers as JSON strings. Use it for compliance or incident review of individual events; use analytics instead for aggregates.

tool_signatures.name: list_collections
tool_signatures.description: List prompt collections in the workspace, optionally filtering by name or workspace. Returns ids, names, slugs, parent collection ids, and timestamps so you can choose a collection_id before create_prompt, get_collection, or list_prompts.

tool_signatures.name: list_config_versions
tool_signatures.description: List every version of a config with version_id, structured config payload, updater, and timestamp. Use this to audit history or compare revisions before update_config or delete_config.

tool_signatures.name: list_configs
tool_signatures.description: List configs in the org with id, slug, name, status, workspace, and timestamps. Use this summary view to find a slug; use get_config for the full routing, cache, retry, and target settings before updating or deleting.

tool_signatures.name: update_access_policy
tool_signatures.description: Replace an access policy

tool_signatures.name: update_collection
tool_signatures.description: update_collection

tool_signatures.name: update_config
tool_signatures.description: Update a config by slug; every call creates a new config version rather than overwriting, so earlier versions stay recoverable via list_config_versions. Only provided fields change: name, status, and all routing/cache/retry settings (cache_mode, cache_max_age, retry_attempts, retry_on_status_codes, strategy_mode, targets) are editable, while the slug stays fixed. Changes apply immediately to every API key and prompt referencing the config. Returns the update acknowledgement and new version_id.
